name: vector-dither
title: Vector Dither
description: A gradient or an image turned into an ordered or pattern dither and rendered as inline SVG: one shape per cell, grouped by color, crisp at any size.
author: Josh Pigford <https://github.com/Shpigford>
docs:
Installed `VectorDither` in `components/ui/` and its dither core (`vector-dither-core.ts`). Render `<VectorDither palette="green" pattern="bayer4" />` for a dithered 45 degree gradient, or `<VectorDither src="/photo.jpg" cellSize={6} alt="..." />` to dither an image (same origin or CORS). The SVG fills the container's width.

The defaults draw 128 x 128 cells; for a lighter page use a smaller `width` or a larger `cellSize`. For an SVG file, call `ditherGenerateSvg(grid, cols, rows, settings)` from the core with a grid from `ditherGradientGrid` or `vectorDitherImageGrid`.
